Tomato___Early_blight.description: Dark concentric-ringed spots on older leaves, often with yellow halos, progressing upward and causing defoliation.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Spray neem oil (5ml/L) or copper-based fungicide every 7-10 days; remove and destroy infected leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP (2.5 g/L) or Chlorothalonil at first symptom onset, repeat every 10-14 days.

Tomato___Late_blight.description: Water-soaked lesions on leaves turning brown/black rapidly, white fungal growth on leaf undersides in humid conditions; can destroy a crop within days.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Copper-based bactericide/fungicide sprays; remove infected plants immediately to prevent spread.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb combination fungicide at 2.5 g/L every 7 days during humid weather.
prevention_tips: Avoid working in fields when wet

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.description: Small water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit that turn dark brown with yellow halos.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Copper hydroxide sprays combined with mancozeb to slow resistance development.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Copper-based bactericides at 7-day intervals; avoid overuse to prevent copper resistance.

Potato___Early_blight.description: Target-board-like brown spots with concentric rings on lower leaves, progressing upward.
Potato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Neem oil or Bacillus subtilis based biofungicide sprays.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb or Azoxystrobin at first sign of infection, repeat every 10 days.

Potato___Late_blight.description: Irregular water-soaked lesions turning brown/purple-black, white mold on leaf undersides.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Copper oxychloride sprays; destroy infected haulms immediately.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Cymoxanil + Mancozeb every 7 days in high humidity periods.

Corn___Common_rust.description: Small, reddish-brown circular to elongated pustules on both leaf surfaces.
Corn___Common_rust.organic_treatment: Sulfur-based fungicide sprays at early pustule stage.
Corn___Common_rust.chemical_treatment: Propiconazole or Azoxystrobin at tasseling stage if severe.

Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.description: Rectangular gray-tan lesions running parallel to leaf veins.
Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.organic_treatment: Crop residue removal and biofungicide (Trichoderma-based) seed treatment.
Corn___Gray_leaf_spot.chemical_treatment: Strobilurin-based fungicides at early tasseling if disease pressure is high.

Apple___Apple_scab.description: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and fruit, causing premature leaf drop and fruit cracking.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_treatment: Sulfur or copper sprays starting at bud break, repeated every 7-10 days.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Myclobutanil or Captan fungicide sprays during wet spring weather.

Grape___Black_rot.description: Circular brown lesions on leaves with black margins; berries shrivel into hard black mummies.
Grape___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Sulfur-based sprays and removal of mummified berries.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb or Myclobutanil from bud break through veraison.

Pepper___Bacterial_spot.description: Small water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit turning brown and scabby.
Pepper___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Copper + Mancozeb tank mix every 7 days during wet weather.

Pest___Aphids.description: Small green/black soft-bodied insects clustering on new growth and leaf undersides, causing curling and sticky honeydew residue.
Pest___Aphids.organic_treatment: Neem oil spray (5 ml/L) or insecticidal soap every 5-7 days; introduce ladybird beetles as biocontrol.
Pest___Aphids.chemical_treatment: Imidacloprid or Acetamiprid systemic insecticide as per label rate.

Pest___Whitefly.description: Tiny white flying insects on leaf undersides; causes yellowing, sooty mold, and virus transmission.
Pest___Whitefly.organic_treatment: Yellow sticky traps combined with neem oil spray every 5 days.
Pest___Whitefly.chemical_treatment: Spiromesifen or Pyriproxyfen as per recommended dosage.
prevention_tips: Use yellow sticky traps for monitoring

Pest___Armyworm.description: Caterpillars feeding on leaves creating ragged holes and window-pane damage, often in whorls of corn/maize.
Pest___Armyworm.organic_treatment: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) spray applied in the evening.
Pest___Armyworm.chemical_treatment: Emamectin benzoate or Chlorantraniliprole per label instructions.

Healthy.description: No visible signs of disease or pest damage detected.
Healthy.organic_treatment: No treatment needed. Continue regular monitoring.
